title: Why Exercise Is Good for Us
article_en: I think everyone loves being healthy. Yes, it is very important to keep our bodies strong. We can stay strong by doing simple exercise. We can run, jump, or play games. Every body is different, but all bodies need good care. If we do not sleep well, we feel tired. Healthy sleep helps us feel better the next day. Some days are beautiful, and that makes us happy to go outside and move. We love the sun and the fresh air. Exercise makes us feel great inside. It helps our hearts and our muscles. We should exercise every day. Even ten minutes is enough. A healthy life is a happy life. Let's start today and never stop. We all want to be strong and ready for the day. So yes, please try to exercise now.
article_zh: 我认为每个人都喜欢保持健康。是的，保持身体强壮非常重要。我们可以通过简单的锻炼来保持强壮。我们可以跑步、跳跃或玩游戏。每个人的身体都不同，但所有身体都需要良好的护理。如果我们没有睡好觉，我们就会感到疲倦。健康的睡眠有助于我们在第二天感觉更好。有些日子很美丽，让我们很高兴去外面活动。我们喜欢阳光和新鲜空气。运动让我们感觉良好。它有助于我们的心脏和肌肉。我们应该每天锻炼。甚至十分钟就够了。健康的生活是快乐的生活。让我们今天就开始，永远不要停止。我们都想变得强壮，为这一天做好准备。所以，是的，请现在就试着锻炼一下。
